tests: Choosing a service that decouples producers and consumers and does not lose messages when the consumer is slow.
expected: An SQS queue between producer and consumer — a buffer; the consumer processes at its own pace. Triggers: "decouple", "slow consumer", "not lose messages during spikes".
why_not: SNS without a subscribed queue — push with no buffer; synchronous HTTP calls couple components; Firehose — stream delivery to storage, not a task queue.
